name: Better Anime Girl?
desc:

Remember to join our group for a unique sword!

[PC] 💻

Left Shift - Shiftlock

[Controller] 🎮
R2 - Atack
B / Circle  - Shiftlock

[Mobile] 📱
Tap the buttons on screen
